items.title: 6 easy ways to use the Figma agent right now
items.excerpt: Figma's own guide to six practical uses of the in-canvas Figma agent: making designs more expressive, automating busywork, and exploring more variations directly on the canvas.

items.title: Try Tabletop: customizable, collaborative spaces built with AI
items.excerpt: Google Labs' new experiment Tabletop lets groups prompt AI to build custom collaborative mini-apps such as interactive itineraries, polls and brackets; waitlist now open.

items.title: AI prototyping inside your design system: a hands-on guide for design & product teams
items.excerpt: Why AI builders hand back a lookalike instead of your real components, what has to exist in a design system before an agent can use it, and the MCP setup the author uses for in-system prototyping.

items.title: Your design job is merging with the ones next to it
items.excerpt: A conversation with Christian Crumlish on what the collapse of typesetting roles teaches designers about AI merging adjacent jobs, and which work is worth keeping.

items.title: Config India 2026: What changed when designers started shipping code
items.excerpt: Freshworks' Sascha Trinkaus on connecting its design system to code so designers can ship, and what happens when they ship faster than teams can judge the ideas.

items.title: Learn Figma Weave in 9 minutes
items.excerpt: Figma's walkthrough of Weave, the node-based workspace that chains AI models and editing tools into repeatable workflows for consistent, production-ready creative assets.

items.title: Bytedance's Seedream 5.5 promises pixel-stable image editing across 100 rounds without color drift
items.excerpt: ByteDance Seed's Seedream 5.5 targets production workflows: stable multi-pass editing up to 100 iterations, native RGBA output with transparent backgrounds, rolling out across Dreamina and CapCut. (Off-list: no on-list render outlet covered it.)

items.title: MiniMax H3 Image and Highspeed now available on AI Gateway
items.excerpt: MiniMax's new open-weights H3 Image model (4K generation and editing) and its Highspeed variant are now callable via Vercel AI Gateway with one API key.

items.title: Creators built playable worlds, VR games and digital pets for Tripo AI's first 3D world hackathon
items.excerpt: More than 2,000 teams from 78 regions used Tripo's AI 3D generation in Tripothon S1, producing games, immersive experiences, creative apps and physical designs.

items.title: So, what are the best AI video generators, and how do they compare on price?
items.excerpt: Creative Bloq compares the top five AI video generators for creatives, including Kling, on hidden costs, credit systems and commercial-use terms.

items.title: Praxis-1 is now available
items.excerpt: Runway releases Praxis-1, its world action model for robotics, with open weights under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face and GitHub, extending its world-model work beyond video.

items.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 accelerates real-world general dexterity
items.excerpt: DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 update pushes general dexterity for physical AI, the embodied-model layer behind next-generation robot product design.

items.title: At CoRL, NVIDIA and partners reveal how robots rehearse delicate work in simulation
items.excerpt: NVIDIA introduces GR00T 2, Isaac Lab 3.0 and new open benchmarks at CoRL, bringing simulation-first precision training to physical-AI robot development.

items.title: Clones and spies (AI is in a weird place right now)
items.excerpt: Engineering.com tests vibe-coded clones of AutoCAD (ArtCraft suite) and Fusion (SolidCraft, browser 3D CAD) and asks whether AI-built CAD clones are the tip of the iceberg.

items.title: Siemens adds agentic AI to HyperLynx verification workflows
items.excerpt: Siemens' new agentic toolkit lets PCB designers run SerDes, DDR, signal- and power-integrity analysis in HyperLynx from natural-language prompts.

items.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
items.excerpt: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling-tower engineering drawings; engineers find the right drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes instead of nearly an hour.

items.title: Creality's new mBox is an AI-enabled 3D printer for kids
items.excerpt: Creality's $329 mBox pairs AI print monitoring with CubeMe and SnapForm, AI tools that turn children's photos or drawings into printable 3D models.

items.title: Mori AI home robot "resembles a contemporary table lamp"
items.excerpt: Cambridge startup OKA designed Mori, a lamp-shaped AI companion robot that greets people, changes light and moves its neck, styled to read as furniture rather than a machine. (Off-list: industrial design of an AI device.)

items.title: Is ArtStation's new AI art policy good enough?
items.excerpt: ArtStation's new rules for AI-generated art try to balance artist protection and disclosure; Creative Bloq weighs whether the policy goes far enough for working creatives.

items.title: Adobe's Google partnership hints at a radically different future for Photoshop
items.excerpt: Adobe and Google are integrating creative tools into Google apps, including Adobe AI editing inside Gemini and PDF editing in Drive. Note: MAX-week adjacent, check against the 11-11 Adobe MAX card.

items.title: Layer launches Motion Designer Agent: game studios can now create campaign-ready UA videos just by chatting
items.excerpt: Layer's Motion Designer Agent lets marketers brief, produce and iterate video ads in one conversation with no motion-design skills. (Off-list; check cross-section dup with marketing/games.)

items.title: Animaj unveils FlipMove AI animation workflow
items.excerpt: Animaj's artist-led FlipMove system carries scenes from approved animatic to finished animation and is already in production on 'Ozzy Fox'. (Off-list; check cross-section dup with movies.)
